related_issues.reason: Closed as not_planned: constraint-dependencies from [tool.uv] ignored for a transitive dependency. Same setting, but the symptom there is multiple versions in uv.lock rather than constraints being ignored entirely.
Open: constraint-dependencies is ignored when set in uv.toml or user-level config. Same setting family, different config location and cause.
Closed as completed: build-constraint-dependencies not propagated by uv sync while working under uv pip. Shows constraint-dependencies handling differs across commands.

rationale: The report names a regression between 0.11.3 and 0.11.8 (rule 2) and the docs (docs/pip/compile.md) say uv reads constraint-dependencies from the workspace-root pyproject.toml, so a silent ignore is plausibly a bug. The post lacks the command, resolved versions and build log, and the pasted constraints contain curly quotes, so a maintainer cannot reproduce or confirm the failure without asking (needs_mre). Searches found no exact duplicate; the closest hits (18337, 9508, 12441) share the setting but not the symptom. Confidence is medium because the reporter's command, which uv subcommand applies the constraints, and whether the file parses are unknown. The read_uv_doc call on docs/reference/settings.md was rejected because the path was not returned by search, so the settings reference was not read.
